description: Prepare a project inquiry draft for the customer to review before it is submitted to The2410. Run plan-project-tool first and provide the existing project_context_id. The customer's name and email are required; company and phone are optional. Returns the project fit, offering, estimate and modules with their price and effort. Delivery dates are indicative; if not calculated, the response explains how to request them. The draft can be changed by calling this tool again. This tool does not submit the inquiry, send an email or delete anything.

comments.description: Comments for the inquiry draft. Omit to keep the current comments.

contact.description: Customer contact details. Name and email are required; company and phone are optional.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

name: prepare-project-inquiry-tool
title: Prepare project inquiry
